Interface SingleFrame

All Superinterfaces:
View
public interface SingleFrame extends View
An application class that is the only view of the main window. Its commands and resources work as in any view.

When the application class implements it, the framework creates the main window and sets its title from the title resource, else the displayed name. It then resolves the application class through the view's child injector, applies its component resources, puts its content, menu bar and toolbar in the window, calls configureFrame(JFrame), restores the saved window state and shows the window. Once the application is ready, it calls ready().
